commands.name: search-locations
commands.summary: Search places worldwide by name; returns location ids (e.g. 1-92416) used by all location commands

commands.name: get-location
commands.summary: Get details for a location id: name, coordinates, elevation, region, time zone and which data types are available (_links)

commands.name: get-forecast
commands.summary: Daily weather forecast (~9-10 days) for a location: symbols, min/max temperature, precipitation, wind

commands.name: get-current-weather
commands.summary: Weather for the current hour at a location: symbol, temperature, feels-like, precipitation, wind, UV index

commands.name: get-nowcast
commands.summary: Radar-based precipitation nowcast for the next 90 minutes in 5-minute steps (Nordic locations)

commands.name: get-long-range-forecast
commands.summary: 21-day (3 weeks) long-range forecast for a location with daily temperature/precipitation percentiles and weekly summaries

commands.name: get-coast-forecast
commands.summary: Coastal/sea forecast for a coastal location: waves, currents, sea temperature plus wind and air temperature per day

commands.name: get-tide
commands.summary: Upcoming high and low tide times and levels (cm) for a Norwegian coastal location

commands.name: get-water-level
commands.summary: Hourly sea water level for ~9 days (astronomical prediction vs. weather-adjusted forecast, cm)

commands.name: get-air-quality
commands.summary: Hourly air quality forecast (index, severity, health description) for a Norwegian location

commands.name: get-aurora-forecast
commands.summary: Hourly northern lights (aurora) forecast: Kp index, aurora activity, darkness and cloud cover

commands.name: get-sun-moon-today
commands.summary: Today's sun and moon details: sunrise/sunset, day length, moon phase, illumination, next full/new moon and eclipses

commands.name: get-celestial-events
commands.summary: Sunrise/sunset and moonrise/moonset events for each day over ~13 days

commands.name: get-water-temperatures
commands.summary: Latest measured water/bathing temperatures at spots nearest to a location

commands.name: get-webcams
commands.summary: Webcams near a location with distance and image URLs

commands.name: list-observation-stations
commands.summary: Weather stations near a location with their last 24h observed temperature, precipitation and wind

commands.name: get-observation-history
commands.summary: Observed weather history from the nearest station: last year, last 30 days, last 25 hours, or a specific date

commands.name: get-location-warnings
commands.summary: Active and upcoming weather warnings (farevarsler) affecting a location; an empty list means no warnings

commands.name: list-warnings
commands.summary: All active weather warnings in Norway (land and marine): title, severity, event type, areas, validity

commands.name: list-regions
commands.summary: List the counties/regions of a country (used to filter warnings by county)

commands.name: list-mountain-passes
commands.summary: All Norwegian mountain passes with open/closed/convoy status, road number and message count (collection fjell-sor = south, fjell-nord = north)

commands.name: get-mountain-pass
commands.summary: Mountain pass detail: open/closed status, road messages (closures, roadworks), road cameras and forecast location ids along the route

commands.name: search-meteorologist-posts
commands.summary: Latest posts from yr's duty meteorologists (Meteorologene), optionally filtered by a keyword in the text, newest first

commands.name: get-meteorologist-post
commands.summary: Get one meteorologist post by its _id (full text, images, thread replies)

dropped.name: get-location-extreme-warnings
dropped.reason: empty list: the example args returned nothing or the selector/resultPath is wrong
